text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning on the day of the Arima Kinen.
Invited by Oguri Cap,
the place we headed to was...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... As expected, this place is really calming.

—The woods behind the academy.
It's Oguri Cap's favorite spot.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Last night,
I found myself remembering all sorts of things."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"The day we first met,
and the days we spent training together..."

Through her calm way of speaking,
all kinds of emotions are conveyed...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
At first, it was solely for the folks back home.
I just wanted to live up to everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, after meeting various rivals...
I realized that I, too, didn't want to lose to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to win,
and make everyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run in a way that makes everyone feel
they were right to support me."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That is my reason...
My reason for wanting to win right now.

Carrying the hopes and dreams of countless people, she has made it this far.
And today, on the grand stage of the Arima Kinen...
she will give them a dream to remember.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "...I came here to win. Therefore, I promise you."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Today, I won't lose to anyone.
Bet all your feelings on me too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... leave it to me!

“—A tremendous roar echoes through the stands.
Chants for Tamamo Cross and Super Creek—the heavyweights of the JRA.”
And among them—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ogurii!!
Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Oguriin!!

Among them was the name of the monster
from the regional circuit: "Oguri Cap."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Call my name, everyone, shout it out loud!
With every cheer, I will... grow stronger!
—And so, the ultimate showdown that is the Arima Kinen began!
